subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most suitable word.

The machine can be ______ to deliver a certain number of coins.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e. **'Set'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, the word **"set" **means to adjust or establish something to achieve a desired state or condition.
 
• So **when we say** "The machine can be set to deliver a certain number of coins", we mean that the machine can be adjusted or programmed to deliver a specific amount of coins.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The machine can be **set** to deliver a certain number of coins.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's take a look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Met":** This is the past tense and past participle of "meet". It does not make sense in this context.
 
• **"Abet":** This means to encourage or assist someone to do something wrong, in particular, to commit a crime or other offense. It does not make sense in this context.
 
• **"Slashed"**: This means to cut something with a violent sweeping movement. In a different context, it could also mean to reduce something drastically. Neither of these meanings fit in this context.
